raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This bar chart illustrates the effect of various language families on different models, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis lists 9 language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the effect, with a scale ranging from 0 to 30, and marked at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a distinct color: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (light pink), and XLM-B2 (red). The bars for each model within a language family have error bars indicating variability. The chart shows that IE-Indic has a notably high effect for several models, particularly for mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2, which have approximate values of 20 and 25, respectively. In contrast, Isolate and Uralic have relatively low effects across all models, with most bars being close to 0 or slightly above. Semitic shows a high effect for XLM-B2, with a value of approximately 20. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
